title: 第25章 万孽蚀骨金丹涅盘第26章 魂幡噬渊睚眦血狩
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
冰冷的、带着浓重腐朽腥气的黑水，如同亿万根细密的毒针，持续不断地刺入阴九幽残破的魔躯。
九劫雷煌体黯淡的暗金魔纹在污水的浸泡下，非但没有愈合的迹象，反而被丝丝缕缕的灰黑色死气侵蚀，发出微不可闻的“滋滋”
声，如同烧红的烙铁浸入冷水。
每一次微弱的呼吸，都牵扯着断裂的经脉和破碎的内腑，带来深入骨髓的剧痛。
金丹大圆满的境界壁垒摇摇欲坠，仿佛随时会彻底崩碎，将他打落凡尘。
他藏身于巨大的兽类骸骨深处，骸骨内部的空间被污浊的淤泥半填满，散发着令人窒息的恶臭。
骸骨外，那两个元婴中期的老魔头——
“老毒物”
骨杖绿光闪烁，警惕地扫视着被阴九幽“血污炸弹”
污染的区域；
“彩泥老妪”
则心疼地安抚着手中萎靡的怨灵，眼神怨毒地逡巡。
他们暂时被那混合了玄姹蚀魂血秽、轮回煞、混乱毁灭气息以及滔天恨意的污染风暴震慑，不敢轻易靠近，但贪婪的神念如同无形的触手，一遍遍扫过这片死寂的水域，寻找着任何可能的生机波动。
阴九幽的意识在剧痛与昏沉的边缘挣扎。
他不敢有丝毫异动，甚至连神念都不敢外放，只能将最后一点微弱的感知力集中在体内。
万魂王煞剑魄魂火蜷缩在识海最深处，如同风中残烛，传递出的不再是凶威，而是劫后余生的恐惧和深入骨髓的虚弱。
轮回本源的自爆，代价惨重到几乎断绝了他的道基，神魂如同被撕裂后又强行粘合的破布，布满了裂痕。
唯有那一点核心的恨意。
冰冷，纯粹，如同万载玄冰深处不灭的星火。
幽瑶那圣洁面具下的狰狞贪婪，玄姹蚀魂血光刺入神魂的极致亵渎与痛苦，轮回巨掌抹杀一切的死亡阴影…

还有这葬骨沼无尽的污浊与恶意…
这一切，如同最残酷的磨刀石，反复淬炼着这缕恨火，使其愈发凝练、冰冷、坚韧！
“力量…我需要…力量…”
破碎的神念在黑暗中无声咆哮。
没有力量，在这元婴遍地走的绝地，他就是一块待宰的肥肉！
没有力量，如何撕碎幽瑶！
如何踏平轮回殿！
如何揪出那操控一切的幕后黑手！
就在他心神紧绷，竭力对抗着内外交困的痛苦与侵蚀时，一种奇异的悸动，自他紧握的那块布满诡异锈蚀纹路的黑色金属碎片上传来。
碎片只有巴掌大小，边缘锋利，触手冰凉刺骨，仿佛能冻结灵魂。
其上的锈蚀纹路并非自然形成，更像是一种极其古老、蕴含着混乱与毁灭本质的符文在岁月侵蚀下的残留。
先前仓促抓住它，只觉一丝微弱的锋芒之气，此刻在阴九幽残破的肉身和混乱神魂的刺激下，这碎片内部仿佛有什么东西…苏醒了！
嗡——！
一股微弱却异常坚韧、冰冷、仿佛能切割万物的源初锋芒，如同沉睡万古的凶兽睁开了眼睛，顺着阴九幽的手掌，猛地刺入他残破的经脉！
“呃！”
阴九幽身体猛地一颤！
这股锋芒之气极其霸道，所过之处，他本就脆弱的经脉如同被无数细小的利刃切割，剧痛钻心！
content_en:
The cold black water with a strong rotting smell was like billions of fine poisonous needles, continuously piercing Yin Jiuyou's broken demonic body.
The dim dark golden magic patterns on the Nine Tribulations Thunder Glory Body showed no signs of healing when soaked in sewage. Instead, they were eroded by strands of gray-black death energy, making an inaudible "sizzling" sound.
The sound was like a red-hot iron being immersed in cold water.
Every weak breath involved the broken meridians and broken internal organs, causing severe pain that penetrated into the bone marrow.
The barrier of the golden elixir's great perfection realm is crumbling, as if it will completely collapse at any time and knock him down to the mortal world.
He was hiding deep in the huge beast skeleton. The space inside the skeleton was half filled with filthy mud, exuding a suffocating stench.
Outside the bones, the two old demons in the middle stage of Nascent Soul—
"Old Poison"
The green light of the bone staff flashed, and it vigilantly scanned the "blood-stained bomb" by Yin Jiuyou.
contaminated areas;
"The old woman with colored clay"
Then he comforted the wilted resentful spirit in his hands distressedly, and his eyes wandered around maliciously.
They were temporarily frightened by the pollution storm that was mixed with the blood and filth of Xuanzang's corrupted soul, the evil of reincarnation, the aura of chaos and destruction, and the overwhelming hatred. They did not dare to approach easily, but their greedy spiritual thoughts were like invisible tentacles, sweeping over this dead water over and over again, looking for any possible fluctuations of life.
Yin Jiuyou's consciousness was struggling on the edge of severe pain and coma.
He didn't dare to make the slightest move, and he didn't even dare to let out his spiritual thoughts. He could only concentrate his last weak perception in his body.
The Soul Fire of the Ten Thousand Soul King's Evil Sword huddled in the deepest part of the sea of ​​consciousness, like a candle in the wind. It no longer conveyed the fierce power, but the fear of the rest of the life and the weakness that penetrated into the bone marrow.
The self-destruction of the source of reincarnation was so costly that it almost severed his Dao foundation. His soul was like a rag that had been torn and then forcibly glued together, full of cracks.
Just that core of hatred.
Cold and pure, like an eternal spark deep in the eternal black ice.
The ferocious greed under Youyao’s holy mask, the extreme blasphemy and pain of Xuansha’s soul-eating blood light penetrating into the soul, the shadow of death that obliterates everything with the giant palm of reincarnation...
And the endless filth and malice of this bone swamp...
All of this, like the cruelest whetstone, repeatedly tempers this fire of hatred, making it more condensed, colder, and tougher!
"Strength...I need...power..."
Broken spiritual thoughts roared silently in the darkness.
Without strength, in this Jedi world where Nascent Soul roams everywhere, he is just a piece of fat waiting to be slaughtered!
How to tear Youyao apart without strength!
How to level the Palace of Reincarnation!
How to find out the mastermind behind everything!
Just when his mind was tense and he was trying his best to resist the pain and erosion of internal and external difficulties, a strange throbbing came from the black metal fragment covered with strange rust patterns that he was holding tightly.
The fragments were only the size of a palm, with sharp edges, and the tentacles were bone-chilling, as if they could freeze the soul.
The rust lines on it are not naturally formed, but more like the remnants of an extremely ancient rune that contains the essence of chaos and destruction eroded by the years.
When I hurriedly grabbed it before, I could only feel a faint edge of energy. Now, under the stimulation of Yin Jiuyou's broken body and chaotic soul, something inside this fragment seemed to... wake up!
Buzz—!
A weak but extremely tough, cold, original edge that seemed to be able to cut through all things opened its eyes like a beast that had been sleeping for eternity, and followed Yin Jiuyou's palm to pierce his broken meridians!
"Ugh!"
Yin Jiuyou's body trembled suddenly!
This sharp energy was extremely overbearing. Wherever it passed, his already fragile meridians felt like being cut by countless tiny sharp blades, causing severe pain!
